thread:
maria: Hey folks — noticed p99 on the new /generate endpoint in the latency dashboard is ~2x higher than the endpoint breakdown for the same time window. Looks like rollups disagree when we include routing to fallback-models. Anyone seen this?
aj: Can you paste the dashboard query? is this across all regions or just eu-west?
maria: It's EU only. Dashboard p99 (consolidated) shows 480ms, endpoint breakdown shows 220ms for main variant + 80ms for fallback => doesn't add up. I suspect sample weighting.
devin: This often comes from the tdigest rollup mode we use for composite routes. we compress histograms at ingest and the downstream merge uses weighted centroids. If routes have different sample counts and we do a per-route percentile then rollup, that can skew p99.
sasha: UX question: can we surface the rollup algorithm in the console? like a little info icon that says "percentile = merged tdigest across selected routes (weighted)"
aj: pls paste the exact query from the metrics backend. also which rollup mode is currently configured for that dashboard?
maria: here's the query I used in the console timeframe quick export:
```sql
SELECT rollup_percentile('tdigest', 0.99) as p99
FROM latency_events
WHERE route IN ('/generate','/generate-fallback') AND region='eu-west'
  AND time >= now() - interval '1h'
GROUP BY rollup_window
```
devin: That SQL + tdigest merge will weight by count. If fallback has fewer samples but much higher tail latency it can dominate merged p99. Alternative: compute per-route p99 then take max or a weighted-mean of p95->p99 corrections.
sasha: For console I'd prefer "show per-route pXX and a 'composite' mode (merge|max|per-route-max)". People get surprised when the composite p99 < max(per-route p99) sometimes.
observability-bot: :warning: alert: p99-latency-eu-west for /generate-fallback breached 400ms threshold at 2025-06-12T10:05Z
aj: ok, two action items: (1) change dashboard to show explicit 'merge mode' in header; (2) add a helper tooltip explaining algorithm + link to docs. I'll open a small PR for dashboard templating.
maria: thanks — can we also add a debug toggle to export per-route sample counts in the same panel? that'll help triage.
devin: agree. I'll prepare a short design doc on rollup semantics and recommended policies (max vs merged) and post it here in a bit.
sasha: tiny UX ask: when the selected routes include fallbacks, show an orange badge "fallbacks included" so PMs don't get surprised.
aj: :thumbsup: tagging @oncall to check if the alert was noise.
oncall: I checked infra — fallback model saw a GC pause during that window, likely real. reopening an infra ticket.
maria: closing loop — thanks everyone. filing a dashboard change and a docs update.
